Policies and Initiatives.title: CM: Take steps to project Bihar’s achievements at national level
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Bihar's Chief Minister, Samrat Choudhary, has directed the information department to strengthen national branding of the state's development achievements. He also tasked officials with identifying government land for revenue generation and improving tourist information at heritage sites. The CM emphasized the use of technology, including AI, to monitor government work in real-time.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Youth are foundation of national progress: Minister
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Bihar's Agriculture Minister Ram Kripal Yadav emphasized the importance of youth in national progress, urging them to be architects of India's future. He stressed the need for innovation and skill development during his address at Dr C V Raman University's convocation. The event also featured the launch of an AI Literacy Meet and other initiatives.

Events.title: IIT-Patna event to focus on AI strategy
Events.summary: IIT-Patna is hosting a pre-event for the India AI Impact Summit 2026, focusing on innovative AI strategies. The event will highlight AI's role in addressing national issues like climate resilience and child safety, as well as promoting startup growth. It aims to showcase cutting-edge AI solutions that drive innovation and progress.

Major AI Developments.title: AI conclave discusses NEP 2020 roadmap for higher education
Major AI Developments.summary: Bihar's higher education sector is aligning with NEP 2020, focusing on AI's potential for assessments and governance. A recent summit in Patna brought together policymakers and technology leaders to discuss innovative educational reforms. The discussion emphasized the importance of ERP systems and data analytics in modernizing the education sector.

Major AI Developments.title: Experts call for data-driven reforms in Bihar healthcare
Major AI Developments.summary: Healthcare experts in Bihar are advocating for data-driven reforms to shift from reactive treatment to a proactive health system. They recommend evidence-based practices, including AI-assisted diagnostics and digital health records. Experts also emphasize the need for advanced training for healthcare workers to support these reforms.

Major AI Developments.title: CPI(ML) seeks joint meeting of GA partners in Bihar
Major AI Developments.summary: CPI(ML) state secretary Kunal is calling for a joint meeting of Grand Alliance partners in Bihar to address urgent issues. The meeting aims to organize protests against the LPG crisis, rising violence against women, and increased electricity tariffs. These protests will bring attention to the escalating problems in the state.

Major AI Developments.title: Conference of gatro surgeons kicks off at IGIMS, to focus on AI in surgery
Major AI Developments.summary: A conference of gastro surgeons has begun at IGIMS, focusing on the role of artificial intelligence in surgery. The event aims to explore the potential applications and benefits of AI in surgical procedures. The conference brings together experts to discuss and share knowledge on the latest advancements in AI-powered surgery.

Major AI Developments.title: Man arrested from Bihar for posting AI-generated images of PM
Major AI Developments.summary: A man from Bihar has been arrested for posting AI-generated images of the Prime Minister. The arrest was made in response to the man's online activities, which allegedly involved creating and sharing fake images using artificial intelligence. The incident highlights the growing concern over the misuse of AI technology for creating and disseminating false information.

Major AI Developments.title: Workshop on AI at IGIMS
Major AI Developments.summary: A workshop on artificial intelligence (AI) was held at the Indira Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences (IGIMS). The event aimed to explore the potential of AI in the medical field, although specific details of the workshop are not provided. The workshop was reported by the Times of India, with a link to the full article available for more information.

Major AI Developments.title: NDA attacks Congress over protest at AI Summit
Major AI Developments.summary: Bihar's NDA leaders have criticized the Youth Congress for protesting at the AI Impact Summit, accusing them of undermining national interests. The NDA characterized the protest as an attempt to tarnish India's global reputation, labeling it a disgraceful endeavor. The protest has been deemed detrimental politics by the NDA, filled with empty rhetoric from Rahul Gandhi and the Congress party.

Major AI Developments.title: Govt plans to set up AI centre of excellence at IIT-P
Major AI Developments.summary: The government plans to establish an AI centre of excellence at the Indian Institute of Technology Patna (IIT-P). This initiative aims to promote research and development in artificial intelligence. The centre will be set up to foster innovation and advancements in the field of AI.

Major AI Developments.title: CNLU holds round table conference on AI
Major AI Developments.summary: CNLU held a round table conference on Artificial Intelligence (AI). The event aimed to discuss various aspects of AI, although specific details of the conference are not provided. The conference was organized by Chanakya National Law University (CNLU), with the goal of exploring the implications and applications of AI.
